claims.statement: Frontend state follows one pattern: a Rust command mutates native state, Rust emits a Tauri event, a frontend listener (usually inside a context provider) updates React state, and components consume the context. frontend/src/services/ contains pure 1:1 invoke/listen wrappers (recordingService, transcriptService, configService, storageService, updateService) that deliberately do not alter error handling, and new commands should be wrapped there.

app/layout.tsx mounts all global providers in a fixed order with RecordingStateProvider outside TranscriptProvider (TranscriptContext consumes useRecordingState for reload sync); the layout also chooses between OnboardingFlow and the main app from get_onboarding_status, forwards the tray's request-recording-toggle event as the start-recording-from-sidebar DOM event, and hosts the import drop overlay/dialog gated on the importAndRetranscribe beta feature.

ConfigContext owns user configuration: summary model config (provider/model/whisperModel/endpoint plus custom-OpenAI fields), transcript model config, selected devices, language, confidence-indicator and auto-summary toggles, localStorage-backed beta features, per-provider API keys (claude/groq/openai/openrouter), and lazily loaded notification settings and storage locations via a ref-guarded loadPreferences().

ConfigContext loads saved config from the backend on mount (api_get_model_config, api_get_transcript_config, get_recording_preferences, api_get_api_key per provider), re-fetches Ollama models whenever the endpoint changes, stays in sync via the model-config-updated event, and syncs language to Rust with set_language_preference on startup and on change to fix a startup desync.

RecordingStateContext is the single source of truth for the recording lifecycle, exposing the RecordingStatus enum (IDLE, STARTING, RECORDING, STOPPING, PROCESSING_TRANSCRIPTS, SAVING, COMPLETED, ERROR), a setStatus setter, and derived isStopping/isProcessing/isSaving helpers.

RecordingStateContext keeps isRecording/isPaused/isActive and durations synced with the backend three ways: listeners on recording-started/stopped/paused/resumed (started enters RECORDING and begins 500ms polling of get_recording_state; stopped enters STOPPING unless already deeper in the stop flow), an initial mount sync that corrects the refresh-desync where the backend records but the UI shows stopped, and periodic 500ms polling while recording.

TranscriptContext buffers transcript-update events in a Map keyed by sequence_id (dropping duplicates), drains the buffer on a 10ms debounce timer, drains consecutive sequence ids plus stale/recent entries, sorts by chunk_start_time then sequence_id, dedupes against already-rendered sequence_ids, and exposes flushBuffer() as a force-flush that processes all remaining entries regardless of timing for the stop flow.

TranscriptContext performs IndexedDB meeting bookkeeping: on recording-started it generates a meeting-{timestamp} id (mirrored to sessionStorage.indexeddb_current_meeting_id), initializes meeting metadata with the backend meeting name and folder path (refreshed from the recording-stopped payload), saves every transcript update non-blocking so IndexedDB failures never interrupt recording, and markMeetingAsSaved() flags the meeting saved and clears both id sources.

On reload during an active recording with an empty local transcript list, TranscriptContext pulls the full segment history from get_transcript_history and the meeting name from get_recording_meeting_name, restoring live-session state after a page refresh.

TranscriptContext owns display behavior: smart auto-scroll that fires only when the user is already at the bottom (10px tolerance, delayed 150ms to match the entry animation) and copyTranscript that formats [MM:SS] recording-relative timestamps from audio_start_time.

SidebarProvider owns the meetings list (refetchMeetings via api_get_meetings), the current meeting (reset to '+ New Call' on /), transcript search (api_search_transcripts), and recording initiation: handleRecordingToggle dispatches start-recording-from-sidebar when already on the home page, otherwise sets sessionStorage.autoStartRecording and navigates to /.

SidebarProvider hosts per-meeting summary polling: startSummaryPolling polls api_get_summary every 5 seconds, stops on completed/error/failed/cancelled (or idle after the first poll, meaning the process vanished), enforces a 200-poll (~16.5 minute) timeout that reports an error, and all intervals are cleaned up on unmount; meeting-details stops polling on navigation away.

RecordingPostProcessingProvider listens for the Rust recording-stop-complete event and runs the full useRecordingStop post-processing flow from any page, covering stops that did not originate in the main UI (tray menu, global shortcut, overlay button); its setIsRecording props are no-ops because RecordingStateContext already owns that state.

useRecordingStart gates every recording start on transcription-model readiness (parakeet_init + parakeet_has_available_models, blocking with a toast while a model downloads, otherwise opening the model selector), generates a 'Meeting DD_MM_YY_HH_MM_SS' title, sets STARTING, and calls start_recording_with_devices_and_meeting with devices from ConfigContext; three entry paths share this logic: the manual button, the sessionStorage.autoStartRecording flag, and the start-recording-from-sidebar DOM event.

The stop sequence divides labor: RecordingControls.stopRecordingAction computes a save path under the app data dir, invokes stop_recording, and then only calls onRecordingStop(callApi); useRecordingStop owns post-stop processing, guarded against concurrent stops by a ref and awaiting the recording-stopped event data (folder path and meeting name parked in sessionStorage) before proceeding.

useRecordingStop waits for transcription by polling get_transcription_status every 500ms for up to 60 seconds, treating transcription as complete when is_processing is false and chunks_in_queue is 0 (or when last_activity_ms exceeds 8s with an empty queue), then waits 4 seconds for late segments and calls flushBuffer() to force-process remaining buffered transcripts.

useRecordingStop saves to SQLite only when callApi is true and transcription completed: it saves the complete transcript array via storageService.saveMeeting preferring the backend meeting name and folder path, applies or detects the summary language, calls markMeetingAsSaved, refetches sidebar meetings, and after 2 seconds navigates to /meeting-details?id=…&source=recording while clearing transcripts and resetting status; failures set ERROR status and toast, and the no-save path returns to IDLE.
useRecordingStop exposes window.handleRecordingStop(callApi) so Rust-side callbacks can trigger the post-stop flow directly from the webview.

useRecordingStateSync (home page) polls is_recording every 1 second to flip the local isRecording flag to match the backend and owns the isRecordingDisabled flag that prevents re-recording while processing.

usePermissionCheck derives hasMicrophone and hasSystemAudio from the Input/Output device counts returned by get_audio_devices, and the home page renders RecordingControls only when a microphone exists or recording is already active.

indexedDBService owns the MeetilyRecoveryDB (v1) with a meetings store (keyPath meetingId, indexed on lastUpdated and savedToSQLite) and a transcripts store (auto-increment id, indexed on meetingId); metadata records title, timestamps, transcript count, savedToSQLite flag, and folder path, and all write failures are logged and swallowed so recovery persistence never interrupts recording.

On startup the home page runs IndexedDB cleanup and recovery checks: it skips entirely while recording or mid-stop (STOPPING/PROCESSING_TRANSCRIPTS/SAVING), calls deleteOldMeetings(7) for meetings older than 7 days and deleteSavedMeetings(24) for meetings saved to SQLite more than 24 hours ago, then checkForRecoverableTranscripts(); the TranscriptRecovery dialog opens at most once per session via the sessionStorage.recovery_dialog_shown flag.

useTranscriptRecovery lists unsaved meetings updated within 7 days but older than ~2 seconds (so a just-stopped, not-yet-saved meeting is not offered) and verifies audio checkpoint availability with has_audio_checkpoints (clearing the folder path on failure); recoverMeeting loads stored transcripts, attempts audio reconstruction via recover_audio_from_checkpoints at 48kHz when a folder path exists, saves through storageService.saveMeeting, applies the pinned summary language, marks the meeting saved, and best-effort runs cleanup_checkpoints (non-fatal).

usePaginatedTranscripts serves meeting-details: it loads api_get_meeting_metadata plus transcripts in 100-segment pages from api_get_meeting_transcripts, dedupes by id, sorts by audio_start_time, debounces loadMore (100ms), resets on meeting change, and supports refetch after retranscription.

useTranscriptStreaming renders a typewriter reveal for the newest segment while recording: 5 characters shown immediately, then the remainder revealed over 800ms in 15ms ticks with scaled charsPerTick, driven by segment id changes and cleared when not recording.

useImportAudio drives the import-audio beta flow: select_and_validate_audio_command (native picker) or validate_audio_file_command (drag-drop) produce file info, start_import_audio_command transcribes with optional language/model/provider, results arrive as import-progress/import-complete/import-error events, cancel_import_command cancels with a ref guard so late events cannot update state after cancel, and on completion ImportAudioDialog navigates to the new meeting while blocking dialog close during processing.

useProcessingProgress is a client-side chunk-progress tracker (default 30-second chunks) with per-chunk start/complete/fail transitions, estimated remaining time, pause/resume/cancel, and localStorage persistence under transcription_progress for resume.

OllamaDownloadContext registers app-lifetime listeners for ollama-model-download-progress/complete/error, keeping per-model progress and a downloading set alive across modal unmounts so background downloads keep reporting.
updateService wraps the Tauri updater: checkForUpdates throttles checks to once per 24 hours unless forced and guards against concurrent checks; downloadAndInstall downloads and relaunches the app.

The app page map is: app/page.tsx (recording home with TranscriptPanel, floating RecordingControls, StatusOverlays, settings modals, and the recovery dialog), app/meeting-details (paginated transcripts plus summary view that normalizes BlockNote summary_json, markdown, and legacy sectioned formats, and auto-generates a summary when navigated with source=recording and isAutoSummary enabled), app/notes/[id] (static placeholder editor not wired to the backend), and app/settings (tabbed General/Recordings/Transcription/Summary/Beta).

RecordingControls enforces a 2-second minimum recording duration, parses backend start errors into device-specific alerts (microphone/system audio/permission), listens for transcript-error, transcription-error, and speech-detected events, and delegates all post-stop work to its onRecordingStop callback.

The AISummary component group renders the sectioned summary (Agenda/Decisions/Action Items/Closing Remarks) with unique block ids, selection, and undo/redo history; BlockNoteSummaryView and BlockNoteEditor provide the BlockNote-based editing surface.
